feature.title: Install Forgejo and Grafana from Keystone on iOS and macOS
feature.description: An operator uses either Keystone app to select Forgejo and Grafana, review the install plan for the target cluster, and install both services with the standard Grafana dashboards.
acceptanceCriteria: Both clients preview the target, charts and standard dashboards before confirmation.
Confirm installs both services and provisions the standard dashboards once; cancel leaves the cluster unchanged.
Surface partial installation failures and allow a safe retry.

bug.title: Preserve Grafana datasource placeholders during Charts dashboard install
bug.description: A dashboard with an unresolved datasource placeholder previews correctly. After local install, Keystone Charts drops the placeholder and renders an empty panel. Plan the fix for iOS and macOS using a synthetic manifest.
acceptanceCriteria: A regression fixture reproduces the placeholder loss at the preview-to-install transition.
Both apps preserve the placeholder until the local installation resolves it, or surface a useful validation error.
Install persists no partial dashboard on validation failure.
